text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5527 with La Petite Academy Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Learning Care Group (MI) Inc.: To extend the term by one (1) year, for new expiration of February 2, 2028, covering childcare center operations and management at Los Angeles International Airport (Robert Lowe)
summary: Extension of childcare center operations contract with La Petite Academy at Los Angeles International Airport through February 2028.
